column1: N2|synonym|集める|あつめる|to gather|v|募集する|ぼしゅうする|to recruit; to invite applications|v|募集する is publicly inviting people to apply.
N2|synonym|謝る|あやまる|to apologise|v|詫びる|わびる|to apologise; to make amends|v|詫びる is formal and written: お詫び申し上げます.
N2|synonym|表す|あらわす|to express; to indicate|v|示す|しめす|to show; to demonstrate|v|示す points to evidence or data; 表す expresses meaning or feeling.
N2|synonym|言う|いう|to say|v|述べる|のべる|to state; to express|v|述べる is formal and used for stating opinions in writing or speeches.
N2|synonym|意見|いけん|opinion|n|主張|しゅちょう|assertion; claim|n|主張 is an opinion pushed insistently and defended.
N2|synonym|以降|いこう|from then on; after|n|以後|いご|after; from now on|n|以後 often warns about future behaviour: 以後気をつけます.
N2|synonym|医者|いしゃ|doctor|n|医師|いし|physician|n|医師 is the professional and legal term; 医者 is what you say in conversation.
N2|synonym|一応|いちおう|for now; just in case|adv|とりあえず|とりあえず|for the time being|adv|とりあえず is doing something first before the rest; 一応 hedges that it is only provisional.
N2|synonym|一斉に|いっせいに|all at once; in unison|adv|同時に|どうじに|at the same time|adv|一斉に stresses many acting together; 同時に is simple simultaneity.
N2|synonym|移動する|いどうする|to move; to travel|v|移る|うつる|to shift; to relocate|v|移る is changing to a new place or state; 移動する is the act of moving.
N2|synonym|意味|いみ|meaning|n|意義|いぎ|significance; value|n|意義 is the worth or point of doing something, not a dictionary definition.
N2|synonym|影響|えいきょう|influence; effect|n|効果|こうか|effect; efficacy|n|効果 is the intended beneficial effect; 影響 is any knock-on effect.
N2|synonym|延期する|えんきする|to postpone|v|先に延ばす|さきにのばす|to put off|v|延期する sets a new date; 先に延ばす just pushes it back.
N2|synonym|援助する|えんじょする|to aid; to support|v|助ける|たすける|to help; to save|v|援助する is organised assistance, usually financial or material.
N2|synonym|大幅に|おおはばに|significantly; sharply|adv|大きく|おおきく|greatly; largely|adv|大幅に is used for numbers and prices moving a lot.
N2|synonym|起こす|おこす|to cause; to give rise to|v|引き起こす|ひきおこす|to bring about; to trigger|v|引き起こす is almost always used for negative consequences.
N2|synonym|驚く|おどろく|to be surprised|v|びっくりする|びっくりする|to be startled|v|びっくりする is casual and spoken; 驚く suits writing.
N2|synonym|各々|おのおの|each; respectively|n|それぞれ|それぞれ|each; individually|n|各々 is formal and written; それぞれ is the spoken word.
N2|synonym|主に|おもに|mainly; chiefly|adv|主として|しゅとして|primarily; principally|adv|主として is stiffer and appears in written analysis and official documents.
N2|synonym|およそ|およそ|approximately; roughly|adv|約|やく|about; approximately|adv|約 attaches directly to a number; およそ can also mean generally speaking.
N2|synonym|開始する|かいしする|to start; to commence|v|始める|はじめる|to begin|v|開始する suits systems, events and announcements.
N2|synonym|会社|かいしゃ|company|n|企業|きぎょう|enterprise; corporation|n|企業 is the word in economic writing; 会社 is where you actually work.
N2|synonym|改善する|かいぜんする|to improve; to make better|v|良くする|よくする|to make better|v|改善する is a business word for fixing a known problem step by step.
N2|synonym|かえって|かえって|contrary to expectation|adv|逆に|ぎゃくに|conversely; the other way round|adv|逆に is spoken and increasingly used as a filler; かえって keeps its full meaning.
N2|synonym|確実|かくじつ|certain; reliable|na|間違いない|まちがいない|there is no mistake|exp|確実 describes a method or outcome; 間違いない is the speaker's own certainty.
N2|synonym|拡大する|かくだいする|to expand; to magnify|v|増大する|ぞうだいする|to grow; to swell|v|拡大する works for images and scope; 増大する is about quantity growing.
N2|synonym|我慢する|がまんする|to put up with; to endure|v|耐える|たえる|to bear; to withstand|v|耐える also describes materials withstanding stress; 我慢する is personal restraint.
N2|synonym|考える|かんがえる|to think; to consider|v|検討する|けんとうする|to examine; to consider|v|検討する is formal consideration before a decision, and often politely defers one.
N2|synonym|完成する|かんせいする|to be completed|v|出来上がる|できあがる|to be finished; to be ready|v|出来上がる is spoken and often used for food and small tasks.
N2|synonym|感想|かんそう|impressions; thoughts|n|印象|いんしょう|impression|n|印象 is how something struck you; 感想 is your considered response afterwards.
N2|synonym|記憶する|きおくする|to memorise; to retain|v|覚える|おぼえる|to learn; to remember|v|記憶する is technical or literary; 覚える is the everyday verb.
N2|synonym|危険|きけん|danger; risk|n|恐れ|おそれ|fear; risk of|n|恐れ appears in warnings: 事故の恐れがあります.
N2|synonym|規則|きそく|rules; regulations|n|規定|きてい|provision; stipulation|n|規定 refers to a specific written clause; 規則 is the body of rules.
N2|synonym|期待する|きたいする|to expect; to look forward to|v|望む|のぞむ|to hope for; to desire|v|期待する assumes it is likely; 望む is simply wanting it.
N2|synonym|希望する|きぼうする|to wish for; to request|v|願う|ねがう|to wish; to pray for|v|希望する appears on forms; 願う is more emotional and often addressed to others.
N2|synonym|決める|きめる|to decide|v|決定する|けっていする|to determine; to resolve|v|決定する is a formal decision by an organisation.
N2|synonym|給料|きゅうりょう|salary; pay|n|賃金|ちんぎん|wages|n|賃金 is the term used in labour law and economics.
N2|synonym|許可する|きょかする|to permit; to authorise|v|許す|ゆるす|to allow; to forgive|v|許す also means to forgive, which 許可する never does.
N2|synonym|区別する|くべつする|to distinguish; to tell apart|v|分ける|わける|to separate; to divide|v|区別する is recognising a difference; 分ける is physically dividing.
N2|synonym|訓練する|くんれんする|to train; to drill|v|練習する|れんしゅうする|to practise|v|訓練する is disciplined training toward competence, often professional.
N2|synonym|経験する|けいけんする|to experience|v|体験する|たいけんする|to experience firsthand|v|体験する is a single vivid experience; 経験 accumulates over time.
N2|synonym|継続する|けいぞくする|to continue; to sustain|v|続ける|つづける|to keep doing|v|継続する suits policies, treatment and memberships.
N2|synonym|結果|けっか|result; outcome|n|成果|せいか|achievement; fruits|n|成果 is a positive result earned by effort; 結果 can be good or bad.
N2|synonym|結局|けっきょく|in the end; after all|adv|最終的に|さいしゅうてきに|ultimately; finally|adv|結局 often carries a hint of resignation; 最終的に is neutral and formal.
N2|synonym|減少する|げんしょうする|to decrease|v|減る|へる|to decrease|v|減少する is written and analytical; 減る is spoken.
N2|synonym|建設する|けんせつする|to construct|v|建てる|たてる|to build|v|建設する suits large infrastructure; 建てる suits a house.
N2|synonym|購入する|こうにゅうする|to purchase|v|買う|かう|to buy|v|購入する is the word on receipts, contracts and business documents.
N2|synonym|断る|ことわる|to refuse; to decline|v|拒否する|きょひする|to reject; to refuse|v|拒否する is flat rejection; 断る allows for a polite decline.
N2|synonym|避ける|さける|to avoid; to steer clear of|v|よける|よける|to dodge; to get out of the way|v|Same kanji, different verbs: よける is a physical dodge, 避ける is often abstract.
N2|synonym|早速|さっそく|at once; right away|adv|すぐに|すぐに|immediately|adv|早速 implies acting promptly on something that just came up, often politely.
N2|synonym|参加する|さんかする|to participate; to take part|v|加わる|くわわる|to join; to be added|v|加わる can mean simply being added to a group or list.
N2|synonym|賛成する|さんせいする|to agree; to approve|v|同意する|どういする|to consent; to concur|v|同意する is formal agreement, including legal consent.
N2|synonym|仕事|しごと|work; job|n|業務|ぎょうむ|duties; operations|n|業務 is the formal word for work tasks inside an organisation.
N2|synonym|次第に|しだいに|gradually; by degrees|adv|徐々に|じょじょに|gradually; little by little|adv|Both are written; 徐々に stresses slow steady steps, 次第に a natural drift.
N2|synonym|実施する|じっしする|to implement; to conduct|v|行う|おこなう|to carry out; to perform|v|実施する is formally putting a plan, survey or policy into effect; 行う is any conducted action.
N2|synonym|しばしば|しばしば|frequently; often|adv|よく|よく|often; well|adv|しばしば is written; よく is the spoken word and also means well.
N2|synonym|支払う|しはらう|to pay|v|払う|はらう|to pay|v|支払う is the formal written form on invoices and contracts.
N2|synonym|習慣|しゅうかん|habit; custom|n|慣習|かんしゅう|convention; established practice|n|慣習 is a social custom of a group; 習慣 can be one person's routine.
N2|synonym|収集する|しゅうしゅうする|to collect; to gather|v|集める|あつめる|to gather; to collect|v|収集する suits data, waste and systematic collections.
N2|synonym|終了する|しゅうりょうする|to end; to conclude|v|終わる|おわる|to end; to finish|v|終了する is the word on screens and schedules: 受付終了.
N2|synonym|主要|しゅよう|main; principal|na|主な|おもな|main; chief|na|主要 is formal and used in headings; 主な is the plainer modifier.
N2|synonym|状況|じょうきょう|situation; circumstances|n|状態|じょうたい|state; condition|n|状況 is the situation around something; 状態 is the condition of the thing itself.
N2|synonym|条件|じょうけん|condition; terms|n|要件|ようけん|requirement; essential condition|n|要件 is a requirement that must be met; 条件 can be any term of an agreement.
N2|synonym|生じる|しょうじる|to arise; to result|v|起こる|おこる|to happen|v|生じる is written and used for problems, differences and effects arising.
N2|synonym|承認する|しょうにんする|to approve; to authorise|v|認める|みとめる|to acknowledge; to accept|v|承認する is a formal act by someone with authority.
N2|synonym|徐々に|じょじょに|gradually|adv|少しずつ|すこしずつ|little by little|adv|少しずつ is spoken and concrete; 徐々に is written.
N2|synonym|少なくとも|すくなくとも|at least|adv|最低でも|さいていでも|at the very least|adv|最低でも is spoken and stresses the bare minimum acceptable.
N2|synonym|製造する|せいぞうする|to manufacture|v|作る|つくる|to make|v|製造する is industrial production at scale.
N2|synonym|せっかく|せっかく|with much effort; kindly|adv|わざわざ|わざわざ|going out of one's way|adv|わざわざ describes the trouble taken; せっかく laments that the effort may go to waste.
N2|synonym|世話|せわ|care; looking after|n|面倒|めんどう|trouble; care|n|面倒 also means bothersome, so 面倒を見る is care but 面倒だ is a complaint.
N2|synonym|選択する|せんたくする|to select; to choose|v|選ぶ|えらぶ|to choose; to pick|v|選択する implies choosing from set options; 選ぶ is any act of choosing.
N2|synonym|増加する|ぞうかする|to increase|v|増える|ふえる|to increase|v|増加する belongs to reports and statistics; 増える is the everyday verb.
N2|synonym|想像する|そうぞうする|to imagine|v|思い浮かべる|おもいうかべる|to picture; to call to mind|v|思い浮かべる is calling up a specific image; 想像する can be inventing something new.
N2|synonym|相当|そうとう|considerably; quite|adv|かなり|かなり|fairly; quite|adv|相当 is formal; かなり is the everyday spoken degree word.
N2|synonym|そのため|そのため|therefore; as a result|exp|したがって|したがって|therefore; consequently|exp|したがって is formal written logic and often opens a conclusion.
N2|synonym|確かに|たしかに|certainly; indeed|adv|間違いなく|まちがいなく|without a doubt|adv|確かに often concedes a point before a but; 間違いなく asserts certainty.
N2|synonym|多少|たしょう|somewhat; more or less|adv|少し|すこし|a little|adv|多少 is formal and hedges; 少し simply states a small amount.
N2|synonym|直ちに|ただちに|immediately; at once|adv|すぐに|すぐに|right away|adv|直ちに is formal and often carries an order: 直ちに避難してください.
N2|synonym|中止する|ちゅうしする|to cancel; to call off|v|やめる|やめる|to stop; to quit|v|中止する is calling off a scheduled event; やめる is a personal decision to stop.
N2|synonym|調査する|ちょうさする|to investigate; to survey|v|調べる|しらべる|to check; to look into|v|調査する is a formal, organised investigation.
N2|synonym|直接|ちょくせつ|directly; in person|adv|じかに|じかに|firsthand; in person|adv|じかに is spoken and stresses no intermediary.
N2|synonym|通過する|つうかする|to pass through|v|通る|とおる|to pass; to go along|v|通過する is used for trains, bills and inspections.
N2|synonym|使う|つかう|to use|v|活用する|かつようする|to make good use of|v|活用する stresses putting something to effective use.
N2|synonym|都合|つごう|convenience; availability|n|事情|じじょう|circumstances; reasons|n|都合 is your schedule; 事情 is the background reasons behind a situation.
N2|synonym|続く|つづく|to continue|v|持続する|じぞくする|to be sustained; to last|v|持続する stresses maintaining a state over time.
N2|synonym|つまり|つまり|in other words; that is|exp|すなわち|すなわち|namely; that is to say|exp|すなわち is written and academic; つまり is fine in speech.
N2|synonym|停止する|ていしする|to halt; to suspend|v|止まる|とまる|to stop|v|停止する is formal and often means suspending a service.
N2|synonym|適当|てきとう|suitable; appropriate|na|ふさわしい|ふさわしい|fitting; becoming|ia|Careful: in speech 適当 usually means haphazard or half-hearted, the opposite of its dictionary sense.
N2|synonym|当然|とうぜん|naturally; of course|na|当たり前|あたりまえ|obvious; taken for granted|na|当たり前 is spoken and can sound dismissive; 当然 is written and neutral.
N2|synonym|到達する|とうたつする|to reach; to attain|v|届く|とどく|to reach; to arrive|v|到達する suits goals and figures; 届く suits parcels and messages.
N2|synonym|特徴|とくちょう|characteristic; feature|n|特色|とくしょく|distinctive feature|n|特色 stresses what makes it stand out from others.
N2|synonym|特に|とくに|especially|adv|とりわけ|とりわけ|above all; particularly|adv|とりわけ is literary and singles out one item from several.
N2|synonym|途中|とちゅう|on the way; midway|n|最中|さいちゅう|in the middle of|n|最中 is the very peak of an ongoing action; 途中 is anywhere along the way.
N2|synonym|突然|とつぜん|suddenly|adv|急に|きゅうに|suddenly; abruptly|adv|突然 stresses that nothing led up to it; 急に can simply mean at short notice.
N2|synonym|届ける|とどける|to deliver; to report|v|配達する|はいたつする|to deliver (goods)|v|配達する is commercial delivery; 届ける also means notifying authorities.
N2|synonym|内容|ないよう|content; substance|n|中身|なかみ|contents; what is inside|n|中身 is physical or informal; 内容 is abstract and written.
N2|synonym|直す|なおす|to fix; to correct|v|修正する|しゅうせいする|to revise; to amend|v|修正する is amending documents, plans and figures.
N2|synonym|なるべく|なるべく|as much as possible|adv|できるだけ|できるだけ|as far as possible|adv|できるだけ is slightly stronger; なるべく softens a request.
N2|synonym|能力|のうりょく|ability|n|実力|じつりょく|real ability; competence|n|実力 is proven ability in practice, as opposed to potential.
N2|synonym|発見する|はっけんする|to discover|v|見つける|みつける|to find|v|発見する is finding something previously unknown; 見つける is finding what you looked for.
N2|synonym|発生する|はっせいする|to occur; to break out|v|起こる|おこる|to happen|v|発生する suits incidents, faults and disasters, and appears in news writing.
N2|synonym|発展する|はってんする|to develop; to expand|v|発達する|はったつする|to develop; to mature|v|発達する is natural growth of abilities or systems; 発展 is expansion of scale.
N2|synonym|発表する|はっぴょうする|to announce; to present|v|公表する|こうひょうする|to make public; to disclose|v|公表する stresses releasing information that was previously withheld.
N2|synonym|判断する|はんだんする|to judge; to decide|v|決める|きめる|to decide|v|判断する is deciding after weighing evidence; 決める is simply settling on something.
N2|synonym|販売する|はんばいする|to sell; to market|v|売る|うる|to sell|v|販売する is commercial selling by a business.
N2|synonym|比較する|ひかくする|to compare|v|比べる|くらべる|to compare|v|比較する is analytical and written; 比べる is the spoken verb.
N2|synonym|費用|ひよう|cost; expense|n|経費|けいひ|expenses; overheads|n|経費 is business expenses that can be claimed.
N2|synonym|含む|ふくむ|to include; to contain|v|含める|ふくめる|to include (deliberately)|v|含む describes what is inside; 含める is the speaker choosing to count it in.
N2|synonym|不足|ふそく|shortage; lack|n|欠乏|けつぼう|deficiency|n|欠乏 is technical and used for nutrients and resources.
N2|synonym|増やす|ふやす|to increase (something)|v|拡充する|かくじゅうする|to expand; to enhance|v|拡充する is expanding a service or facility, common in policy writing.
N2|synonym|減らす|へらす|to reduce|v|削減する|さくげんする|to cut; to slash|v|削減する is the business word for cutting costs and staff.
N2|synonym|報告する|ほうこくする|to report|v|知らせる|しらせる|to inform; to let know|v|報告する is upward, to a superior or an organisation.
N2|synonym|方法|ほうほう|method; means|n|手段|しゅだん|means; measure|n|手段 is the instrument used to reach a goal, and can imply doing whatever it takes.
N2|synonym|訪問する|ほうもんする|to visit; to call on|v|訪ねる|たずねる|to visit|v|訪問する is official or business visiting; 訪ねる is personal.
N2|synonym|保護する|ほごする|to protect; to safeguard|v|守る|まもる|to protect; to keep|v|保護する is official protection of the vulnerable or of data.
N2|synonym|保存する|ほぞんする|to preserve; to save|v|取っておく|とっておく|to keep; to set aside|v|取っておく is casual and personal — keeping something for later.
N2|synonym|ほとんど|ほとんど|almost; most of|adv|大部分|だいぶぶん|the greater part|n|大部分 is a noun used in writing; ほとんど is an adverb used in speech.
N2|synonym|自ら|みずから|oneself; personally|adv|自分で|じぶんで|by oneself|adv|自ら is formal and emphasises taking the initiative.
N2|synonym|認める|みとめる|to recognise; to admit|v|評価する|ひょうかする|to appreciate; to rate|v|評価する is judging worth, and in the positive sense means to think highly of.
N2|synonym|見る|みる|to look; to watch|v|観察する|かんさつする|to observe|v|観察する is watching carefully to learn something.
N2|synonym|むしろ|むしろ|rather; if anything|adv|かえって|かえって|on the contrary; instead|adv|かえって means the result was the opposite of what was intended; むしろ compares two options.
N2|synonym|明確|めいかく|clear; definite|na|はっきり|はっきり|clearly; plainly|adv|明確 is a formal adjective for statements and rules; はっきり is a spoken adverb.
N2|synonym|命令する|めいれいする|to order; to command|v|指示する|しじする|to instruct; to direct|v|指示する is workplace instruction; 命令する implies authority and no refusal.
N2|synonym|目立つ|めだつ|to stand out|v|際立つ|きわだつ|to be conspicuous; to stand out|v|際立つ is written and usually positive; 目立つ can be neutral or negative.
N2|synonym|めったに|めったに|rarely; seldom|adv|ほとんど|ほとんど|hardly|adv|Both require a negative verb: めったに行かない, ほとんど行かない.
N2|synonym|問題|もんだい|problem; issue|n|課題|かだい|challenge; task|n|課題 is a problem framed as something to work on; it is also homework.
N2|synonym|やはり|やはり|as expected; after all|adv|思った通り|おもったとおり|just as I thought|exp|やはり confirms an expectation and softens to やっぱり in speech.
N2|synonym|やめる|やめる|to quit; to give up|v|中断する|ちゅうだんする|to interrupt; to suspend|v|中断する is stopping partway with the option of resuming.
N2|synonym|要求する|ようきゅうする|to demand; to request|v|求める|もとめる|to seek; to ask for|v|要求する is forceful and can sound confrontational; 求める is neutral.
N2|synonym|予想する|よそうする|to expect; to anticipate|v|予測する|よそくする|to forecast; to predict|v|予測する implies data and analysis; 予想する can be a hunch.
N2|synonym|理由|りゆう|reason|n|根拠|こんきょ|grounds; basis|n|根拠 is evidence supporting a claim, not motivation for an action.
N2|synonym|利用する|りようする|to utilise; to make use of|v|使用する|しようする|to use; to employ|v|使用する is physical use of an object; 利用する is using a service or opportunity.
N2|synonym|わずか|わずか|only; a mere|adv|ほんの少し|ほんのすこし|just a little|adv|わずか emphasises how small the amount is, often with surprise.
N2|synonym|渡す|わたす|to hand over|v|提出する|ていしゅつする|to submit|v|提出する is submitting documents to an authority.
N2|synonym|我々|われわれ|we; us|n|私たち|わたしたち|we; us|n|我々 is formal, speech-like and male-leaning; 私たち is neutral.
N2|antonym|安定|あんてい|stability|n|不安定|ふあんてい|instability|n|
